note: Family campground at Lakewood in the Chequamegon-Nicolet National Forest, with a heated pool, a game room and an ATV access route from the campground toward the Oconto County trails. Mostly seasonal and monthly: 29 of its 114 RV sites are sold by the night; more than half the sites are long-term. Renters must be 21 or older. --Claude
